title: Volume Overlay — Atrium Showcase
description: Dedicated showcase for VolumeOverlayPanel — three visualisation techniques (slice plane, iso-surface, streamlines) driven from the same VoxelGrid + VectorGrid pair. Scene is a simple double-height atrium (procedural geometry, no model load) so the volumetric data reads as the focus rather than the building. The thermal field shows vertical stratification + a Gaussian heat plume; the companion vector field gives natural-convection streamlines (buoyant updraft + radial inflow at the floor + ceiling outflow). Switch techniques live from the panel's Technique selector.
